exposure: anxiety disorder with an onset 6 months prior to pregnancy
conflicts with relatives other than partner
cohort: A total of 359 pregnant women who gave birth at the inpatient unit of Gynecology and Obstetrics of the University of Campania "Luigi Vanvitelli" from December 2019 to February 2021 were recruited within 3 days from delivery.
finding: The presence of maternity blues significantly increased the risk of having a higher EPDS score at follow-up assessments, with the risk remaining elevated up to 12 months post-delivery.
